text: I. Core Positioning of the DisciplineChemical Engineering and Technology focuses on the transformation and separation of substances, the enhancement and optimization of processes, and the large-scale production of products. It centers on the core issue of "how can chemical reactions be efficiently transformed into industrial productivity". It not only covers traditional chemical engineering (such as petrochemicals and coal-based chemicals), but also deeply intersects with emerging fields such as new energy (such as battery material preparation), biotechnology (such as vaccine production), environmental engineering (such as pollutant treatment), etc. It serves as a crucial bridge connecting chemical principles and engineering practice.II. Training ObjectivesTo cultivate high-quality engineering talents with solid knowledge of chemical engineering and technology, strong engineering practice abilities, and innovative thinking, who can engage in process design, production management, technology research and development, engineering consultation, quality control, etc. in fields such as chemical engineering, energy, environmental protection, materials, medicine, and light industry.
